positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led CloudWAF team, from a proof-of-concept to over a hundred deployments for customers and prospects across
multiple regions globally, handling 2.5k RPS with autoscaling up to 6K RPS
• Set technical direction the CloudWAF service, notably for dynamic provisioning of cloud infrastructure, management of customer certificates and integration with new in-house reverse proxy
• Established processes such as retrospectives and planning meetings in order to improve collaboration across multiple departments and within the team
• Grew CloudWAF team from 3 to 8, interviewing and training new hires
• Led successful major version upgrade of MongoDB, creating disaster recovery plans and upgrade processes in collaboration with SRE team
• Led the design and implementation of integrating Signal Sciences (Fastly) event data with Okta's risk partner API
• Contributed to Fastly and Signal Sciences data integration efforts using Kafka and go-wasm

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led team of 4 in Proximity Designer product (UI tool that enables advertisers to target users by location) which is responsible for ~20% of revenue
• Established team-specific Code Review Best Practices, and Code of Conduct
• Tech lead and product manager of new Delivery Management UI, set to decrease delivery time by 30%
• Contributed to Engine Demo App (Android Java and React Native apps), which allowed sales team to showcase Factual's mobile SDK
• Upgraded session management from cookies to cache stores after discovering and patching a replay attack

positions.title: Data Technologist
positions.description:
• Improved and automated processes of data extraction and cleanup
• Automated manual updates on Excel docs to Python scripts using pandas and Hive Query Language
• Created documentation on previous and new processes and code
• Introduced best-practices on version control, code comments, code reviews and style.
• Created web-based data visualization using d3.js libraries, replacing Powerpoint-based reports

positions.title: Online Marketer
positions.description:
• Project lead for implementing new site launch, in partnership with Product/Engineering
• Used Javascript, Ruby, and HTML5, and SASS for creating the new site (onemedical.com/nyc)
• Write bug fixes and other features as unofficial engineering support for marketing team
• Acquired ~3000 new members in 2013 through organic search, a 31% YOY growth, with
a 50% YOY growth in organic site traffic
• Analyzed online performance for search, site, and acquisition with Google Analytics,
!BrightEdge, and other analytics tools.

positions.title: Marketing & Public Relations Intern
positions.description:
• Developed copy for internal e-newsletters, emails, and press releases
• Supported BBBS - SD County’s website (a Wordpress based site)

positions.description:
(California Pacific Public Health Training Center (Public Health Department)
• Designed and created the first e-newsletter for the California Pacific Public Health Training
Center (CPPHTC), an organization under UC Berkeley’s Public Health Department

honors.title: Hackathon: "Real World Insights and Sales Enabler"
